# AI Tool Rank

> A directory that recommends AI tools by use case, with editorial ratings, verified new releases and verified deals. Last updated 2026-10-30.

Ratings are editorial opinions, not benchmarks. Pricing changes often; the directory does not list prices it hasn't confirmed, so check each official site. New releases are only added after checking the maker's own launch post, which is linked as the source.

## Pages
- [New releases](https://aitooldirectory-beta.vercel.app/new.html): newest verified AI tool launches with dates and source posts
- [Deals](https://aitooldirectory-beta.vercel.app/deals.html): verified student, startup and free-tier offers
- [Compare](https://aitooldirectory-beta.vercel.app/compare.html): side-by-side tool comparison
- [Methodology](https://aitooldirectory-beta.vercel.app/methodology.html): how tools are rated
- [Newsletter archive](https://aitooldirectory-beta.vercel.app/newsletter/index.html): past issues of the weekly newsletter
- [Newsletter Oct 29, 2026](https://aitooldirectory-beta.vercel.app/newsletter/2026-10-29.html): Gemini 4 Carbon, a free local-AI Mac app, and chat-based video editing

## Video
Text-to-video, AI editing and auto-captions. Full ranking: https://aitooldirectory-beta.vercel.app/category/video.html

- #1 [Runway](https://runwayml.com): best for cinematic ai video generation. Leading generative video suite used by creators and studios. (rated 8.5/10, free option offered)
- #2 [Descript](https://www.descript.com): best for editing video by editing text. Edit video and podcasts like a doc. (rated 8.5/10, free option offered)
- #3 [Luma Dream Machine](https://lumalabs.ai): best for realistic motion from prompts. Luma's generative video model and app. (rated 8.0/10, free option offered)
- #4 [Pika](https://pika.art): best for quick, playful video clips. Fast, social-friendly AI video generation. (rated 7.5/10, free option offered)
- #5 [Captions](https://www.captions.ai): best for auto-captioned talking-head videos. Mobile-first AI captions and editing for creators. (rated 7.5/10, free option offered)
- #6 [HeyGen](https://www.heygen.com): best for ai avatar presenter videos. Avatar and video translation platform. (rated 7.5/10, free option offered)
- #7 [Cardboard](https://www.cardboard.ai/): best for editing videos by describing the edit in chat. Agentic AI video editor for the browser and Mac, now usable inside ChatGPT and Claude. Launched for ChatGPT and Claude Oct 26, 2026. (not yet rated, free option offered, released 2026-10-26 ([launch post](https://x.com/ishandeveloper/status/2114785370349187268)))

- #7 [Canva Craft](https://www.canva.com/newsroom/news/canva-craft/): best for design-focused image generation inside canva. Canva's first in-house image model, built for design. Launched Oct 22, 2026. (not yet rated, free option not confirmed, released 2026-10-22 ([launch post](https://x.com/canva/status/2113348707223753165)))

## Free & Open Source
Local models and open-source AI tools. Full ranking: https://aitooldirectory-beta.vercel.app/category/opensource.html

- #1 [Ollama](https://ollama.com): best for running llms locally. Easiest way to run open models locally. (rated 9.0/10, free option offered)
- #2 [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co): best for finding open models. The hub for open models and datasets. (rated 9.0/10, free option offered)
- #3 [LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai): best for desktop app for local models. GUI for downloading and chatting with local models. (rated 8.5/10, free option offered)
- #4 [ComfyUI](https://www.comfy.org): best for node-based image/video pipelines. Powerful open-source diffusion UI. (rated 8.5/10, free option offered)
- #5 [Open WebUI](https://openwebui.com): best for self-hosted chatgpt-style ui. Self-hostable chat UI for local models. (rated 8.0/10, free option offered)
- #6 [Ling-3.0-flash-Sante](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-Sante): best for open-source healthcare research and medical reasoning. Ant Ling's open-source healthcare model. Weights released Oct 22, 2026. (not yet rated, free option offered, released 2026-10-22 ([launch post](https://x.com/AntLingAGI/status/2113293431435149349)))
- #7 [Nativ](https://runnativ.ai): best for running open ai models privately on an apple silicon mac. Open-source Mac app from Neywa Labs for running open language, vision, audio and code models locally and offline. Neywa Labs came out of stealth Oct 27, 2026. (not yet rated, free option offered, released 2026-10-27 ([launch post](https://x.com/Prince_Canuma/status/2115128700379566155)))
- #8 [Mistral Large 4](https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-large-4-oss/): best for self-hosted agentic coding and cyber defense on open weights. Mistral's 1T-parameter multimodal model (nicknamed Le Chonk), with open weights released Oct 29, 2026. (not yet rated, free option not confirmed, released 2026-10-29 ([launch post](https://x.com/MistralAI/status/2115811242556137820)))
